# CIT (HUBEI) PROTECTIVE PRODUCTS CO., LTD.

> > Leading Chinese manufacturer of disposable protective equipment including face masks, isolation gowns, coveralls, ESD garments, and medical supplies based in Xiantao, Hubei.

CIT (HUBEI) PROTECTIVE PRODUCTS CO., LTD. is an ISO13485-certified manufacturer specializing in nonwoven protective products and PPE. The company exports to North America, South America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, Oceania, and the Middle East.

## Key Topics

- Face masks and respirators
- Isolation gowns and coveralls
- Disposable protective equipment (PPE)
- ESD garments and antistatic clothing
- Nonwoven medical supplies
- Chemical resistant aprons
- CPE gowns and protective wear
- ISO13485 certified manufacturing
- Xiantao, Hubei production base
- Medical-grade protective products
- Disposable head covers
- Waterproof protective garments
- Healthcare and industrial PPE
- Made-in-China supplier
